ei.title: Tips and Tricks for a Healthier Digital Life

fullPassage:
Tips and Tricks for a Healthier Digital Life

Managing our digital lives can be challenging. Do you sometimes worry that your online content might face copyright issues? Have you ever felt that you were being overly influenced by online shopping recommendations? Are you constantly checking for likes and comments on your social media posts? If you answered yes to any of these questions, here are some tips and ideas to help you have a healthier digital life.

Avoid Copyright Violations
Cathy is an enthusiastic gamer who shares her gameplays on a popular video-sharing platform. Recently, her channel was suspended for copyright violation issues. She was shocked to learn that the background music played within the game had a copyright claim. Now Cathy wants to know how to avoid similar issues in the future.

Cathy's mistake is not uncommon in the content creation community. Creators often miss embedded copyrighted material, such as background music, sound effects, images, and video clips. Even a brief appearance of such material can put creators at risk of a copyright claim.

To avoid any potential copyright issues, creators should research their creation to check if any of its components are copyrighted. If they come across copyrighted content, they should contact the copyright owner for permission to use it, replace it with non-copyrighted material, or remove it completely. Utilizing material with a Creative Commons (CC) license might also be a good idea. Most of this material can be used at no cost as long as certain rules are followed. These simple steps can help content creators avoid unexpected copyright issues and have some peace of mind about their work.

Break Free from Filter Bubbles
Meet Alex, a high school student with a passion for fashion. He often finds inspiration on social media and enjoys shopping online. Recently, however, he has realized that he keeps buying the same style of clothes. Even when he wants to try out new styles, he has a difficult time getting fresh ideas or recommendations on his preferred online platforms.

Alex is trapped in a filter bubble! Online shops and social media platforms use algorithms to "filter" out content for you based on your past purchases, likes, and search history. As a result, you might find yourself stuck inside a "bubble" of limited information that only reinforces your existing beliefs and preferences. If Alex had been aware of this, he wouldn't have missed out on new and diverse styles outside his bubble.

To stay away from filter bubbles, it is important to regularly check whether you are already trapped inside one. One way to do this is by performing searches on your favorite online platforms after logging out. Compare the search results and recommendations with what you usually see when you are logged in. If there is a big difference between them, you may have been trapped in a filter bubble.

Managing your personal information is another key to avoiding filter bubbles. Whenever you go online, your activities are saved as cookies on your computer. Websites can collect them based on your consent. You can remove or limit your consent on the websites or delete the cookies on your computer on a regular basis. This way, you can reduce the amount of personal data that you unconsciously share as you visit websites. Take action to break free from your filter bubble and open yourself up to new ideas.

Be Happy on Social Media
Social media is a big part of Min's life. She posts photos every day and enjoys getting likes and comments. Lately, however, she began to be concerned about her social media activity. She realizes that she spends a considerable amount of time repeatedly checking her feed, desperately seeking more likes. She even feels disappointed when she sees her friends' posts receiving more likes than hers.

Social media is a powerful tool that helps us connect with others, but it also has its downsides. One of them is that many people place excessive value on the number of likes and comments they get on their posts. Those who feel that they don't get enough likes, like Min, may experience feelings of shame or rejection. This can lead to severe anxiety. In addition, comparing their posts with more popular ones can make them feel inferior and harm their self-esteem. It can even cause depression.

To make social media a positive part of your daily life, it is important to use it mindfully with some guidelines. First, don't let social media consume all your time and attention. A quick and easy way to do this is to set limits on your usage or take regular breaks from social media. This will free up your time and energy to engage in activities outside the online world. Second, keep in mind that social media is a tool to network with others, not a platform for competition. When you start to feel unpopular or inferior, remember that what you see online presents only the highlights of other people's lives and does not reflect their entire story. If you still feel envious, use that emotion as motivation that helps you with your personal growth. By following these rules, you can make the most of social media and feel more at ease in your digital interactions.

questions.passage: Cathy's mistake is not uncommon in the content creation community. Creators often miss ①<u>embedded</u> copyrighted material, such as background music, sound effects, images, and video clips. To avoid any potential copyright issues, creators should research their creation ②<u>checking</u> if any of its components are copyrighted. If they come across copyrighted content, they should contact the copyright owner for permission ③<u>to use</u> it, replace it with non-copyrighted material, or ④<u>remove</u> it completely.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② 원문은 'to check'인데 'checking'으로 바뀌었다. 목적의 to부정사(~를 확인하기 위해) 구문.
det.analysis:
✅ ① embedded: 과거분사 (내장된 저작권 자료)
❌ ② checking → to check: research their creation to check (목적의 to부정사)
✅ ③ to use: permission to V (~할 허락)
✅ ④ remove: 병렬 구조 (contact, replace, or remove)
det.tip: to check = ~를 확인하기 위해 (목적의 to부정사). research ~ to check (O).

questions.passage: Meet Alex, a high school student with a passion for fashion. He often finds ①<u>inspiration</u> on social media and enjoys ②<u>shopping</u> online. Recently, however, he has realized that he keeps ③<u>to buy</u> the same style of clothes. Even when he wants to try out new styles, he has a difficult time ④<u>getting</u> fresh ideas or recommendations on his preferred online platforms.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ 원문은 'buying'인데 'to buy'로 바뀌었다. keep + V-ing(계속 ~하다) 구문.
det.analysis:
✅ ① inspiration: 명사 (영감을 찾다)
✅ ② shopping: enjoy + V-ing (쇼핑을 즐기다)
❌ ③ to buy → buying: keep + V-ing (계속 ~하다). keep to buy (X)
✅ ④ getting: have a difficult time + V-ing (~하는 데 어려움을 겪다)
det.tip: keep + V-ing: 계속 ~하다. keep + to V (X). have a time + V-ing도 동명사.

questions.passage: A quick and easy way to do this is ①<u>to set</u> limits on your usage or take regular breaks from social media. This will free up your time and energy to engage in activities outside the online world. Second, keep in mind that social media is a tool ②<u>to network</u> with others, not a platform for competition. When you start to feel unpopular or inferior, remember that ③<u>what</u> you see online presents only the highlights of other people's lives and ④<u>do</u> not reflect their entire story.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ 원문은 'does not reflect'인데 'do not reflect'로 바뀌었다. 주어 what you see online은 단수 취급.
det.analysis:
✅ ① to set: 보어 역할 to부정사 (way is to set)
✅ ② to network: 형용사적 to부정사 (a tool to network)
✅ ③ what: 선행사 포함 관계대명사 (what you see = 당신이 보는 것)
❌ ④ do → does: what절 주어는 단수 취급 → does not reflect
det.tip: what + S + V는 단수 취급: What you see online presents... and does not reflect... 주어-동사 수일치.

questions.passage: Recently, her channel was ①<u>suspended</u> for copyright violation issues. She was shocked to learn that the background music played within the game had a copyright claim. Cathy's mistake is not ②<u>uncommon</u> in the content creation community. Creators often miss embedded copyrighted material. Even a ③<u>brief</u> appearance of such material can put creators at ④<u>ease</u> of a copyright claim.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ 원문은 'risk(위험)'인데 'ease(안심)'로 바뀌었다. 저작권 자료의 잠깐 등장도 저작권 클레임의 위험에 빠뜨린다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① suspended(정지된): 원문 일치
✅ ② uncommon(드물지 않은): 원문 일치
✅ ③ brief(짧은): 원문 일치
❌ ④ ease(안심) → risk(위험): at risk of = ~의 위험에 처한
det.tip: at risk of(~의 위험에) ↔ at ease(편안한). 저작권 침해 = risk.

questions.passage: Managing your personal information is another key to avoiding filter bubbles. Whenever you go online, your activities are saved as cookies on your computer. Websites can collect them based on your ①<u>consent</u>. You can remove or limit your consent on the websites or delete the cookies on your computer on a regular basis. This way, you can ②<u>reduce</u> the amount of personal data that you ③<u>consciously</u> share as you visit websites. Take action to break free from your filter bubble and ④<u>open</u> yourself up to new ideas.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ 원문은 'unconsciously(무의식적으로)'인데 'consciously(의식적으로)'로 바뀌었다. 웹사이트 방문 시 무의식적으로 공유되는 데이터다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① consent(동의): 원문 일치
✅ ② reduce(줄이다): 원문 일치
❌ ③ consciously(의식적으로) → unconsciously(무의식적으로): 자신도 모르게 공유
✅ ④ open(열다): 원문 일치
det.tip: unconsciously(무의식적으로) ↔ consciously(의식적으로). 데이터는 자기도 모르게 공유된다.

She even feels __________ when she sees her friends' posts receiving more likes than hers.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 친구의 게시물이 더 많은 좋아요를 받으면 실망감(disappointed)을 느낀다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ disappointed: 원문 일치. 비교에서 오는 부정적 감정
❌ ① satisfied(만족한): 문맥상 반대
❌ ② grateful(감사한): 문맥상 반대
❌ ④ indifferent(무관심한): desperately seeking과 모순
det.tip: disappointed = 실망한. 좋아요 수 비교 → 상대적 박탈감.

questions.passage: Whenever you go online, your activities are saved as cookies on your computer. Websites can collect them based on your consent. You can remove or limit your consent on the websites or delete the cookies on your computer on a regular basis. This way, you can reduce the amount of personal data that you __________ share as you visit websites.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 웹사이트 방문 시 무의식적으로(unconsciously) 공유하는 개인 데이터를 줄일 수 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② unconsciously: 원문 일치. 자기도 모르게 공유되는 데이터
❌ ① deliberately(의도적으로): 쿠키 저장은 의도적이 아님
❌ ③ selectively(선택적으로): 선택적 공유가 아님
❌ ④ reluctantly(마지못해): 인식조차 못 하는 상황
det.tip: unconsciously = 무의식적으로. 쿠키는 사용자가 모르는 사이에 활동 기록을 저장.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: Cathy는 게임 배경 음악을 직접 작곡했다.
Cathy는 앞으로도 같은 방식으로 활동할 계획이다.

det.korean: ② 원문: 'her channel was suspended for copyright violation issues.' 일치.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 저작권 위반으로 채널 정지: 원문 일치
❌ ① gamer(게이머)이지 musician 아님
❌ ③ 게임 내 배경 음악이지 직접 작곡 아님
❌ ④ 같은 문제를 피하는 방법을 알고 싶어 함
det.tip: enthusiastic gamer = 열정적인 게이머. suspended = 정지된.

ch: Alex는 항상 다양한 스타일의 옷을 구매한다.
Alex는 온라인 쇼핑보다 오프라인 쇼핑을 선호한다.
Alex는 새로운 스타일의 추천을 쉽게 받고 있다.

det.korean: ① 원문: 'a high school student with a passion for fashion.' 일치.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 패션에 열정 있는 고등학생: 원문 일치
❌ ② 같은 스타일만 계속 구매 (keeps buying the same style)
❌ ③ 온라인 쇼핑을 즐김 (enjoys shopping online)
❌ ④ 새 아이디어 얻기 어려움 (has a difficult time getting fresh ideas)
det.tip: a passion for fashion = 패션에 대한 열정. keeps buying the same style = 같은 스타일 반복 구매.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
ch: 소셜 미디어는 다른 사람들과 소통하는 데 도움이 된다.
많은 사람들이 좋아요와 댓글 수에 과도한 가치를 둔다.
충분한 좋아요를 받지 못하면 수치심이나 거부감을 느낄 수 있다.

det.korean: ④ 원문: 비교하면 feel inferior(열등감) + harm self-esteem(자존감 훼손). 자존감이 '높아진다'는 거짓.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ 자존감이 높아진다 → 원문은 자존감이 해를 입는다(harm their self-esteem). 정반대
✅ ① connect with others: 원문 일치
✅ ② excessive value on likes: 원문 일치
✅ ③ feelings of shame or rejection: 원문 일치
det.tip: harm self-esteem = 자존감을 해치다. 비교 → 열등감 → 자존감 하락.

det.korean: 글의 주제: 저작권 문제를 예방하기 위한 실질적인 방법.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 조사 → 허락/대체/삭제 → CC 라이선스 활용 = 실질적 예방법
❌ ① CC 라이선스의 법적 효력이 아니라 활용 팁
❌ ② 수익 창출 언급 없음
❌ ④ 플랫폼 정책 변화 언급 없음
det.tip: 핵심: research → contact/replace/remove → CC license. 단계별 예방법.

det.korean: 글의 주제: 소셜 미디어를 긍정적으로 활용하기 위한 마음가짐과 지침.
det.analysis:
✅ ① mindfully + guidelines + make the most of = 긍정적 활용 지침
❌ ② 심리학적 원인 분석이 아니라 실천 지침
❌ ③ 완전히 끊는 것이 아니라 의식적 사용

det.tip: 핵심 키워드: mindfully, guidelines, make the most of. 긍정적 활용법.

det.analysis:
✅ ④ peace of mind: 원문 일치. 저작권 문제 예방 → 안심
❌ ① regret(후회): 문맥상 반대, 해결책 제시 후 긍정적 결과
❌ ② confusion(혼란): 문맥상 부적절
❌ ③ competition(경쟁): 저작권과 무관
det.tip: peace of mind = 마음의 평화, 안심. 저작권 문제 예방 후 얻는 심리적 안정.

❌ ③ search history: 안에 갇힌다는 표현 부적절
❌ ④ shopping recommendation: 문맥 무관
det.tip: one = 앞에 나온 단수 명사를 대신. filter bubble → trapped inside one.

❌ ② copyrighted material: 확인 대상이지 소유 대상 아님
❌ ③ community: 문맥상 무관
❌ ④ copyright claim: 결과이지 소유 대상 아님
det.tip: its = 단수 소유격. their creation → its components. 창작물의 구성 요소.
